commands.stdout:
usage: ai-lab setup [-h] [--json] [--model {deepseek,qwen38,clm}]
                    [--with-models] [--doctor] [--yes]
                    [{list,install,download,repair,repair-runtime,doctor}]
                    [MODEL ...]

List installation status, or explicitly download and repair supported local
models

positional arguments:
  {list,install,download,repair,repair-runtime,doctor}
                        Default: list; install/download/repair default to all
                        supported models
  MODEL                 One or more of: deepseek, qwen38, clm

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json
  --model {deepseek,qwen38,clm}
                        Select a local model; may be repeated
  --with-models         Select all supported local models
  --doctor              Inspect platform and runtime prerequisites
  --yes                 Accept explicit model/runtime downloads and repairs

usage: ai-lab services [-h] [--action {list,start,stop,restart,interrupt}]
                       [--name NAME |
                       --model {deepseek,qwen38,contrastive,jev}] [--json]

Internal scripted service supervision; no terminal screen. Saved profiles
share their backend server; interrupt stops the entire service.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --action {list,start,stop,restart,interrupt}
                        Script an explicit action; start/restart stay in the
                        foreground
  --name NAME           Exact saved generation profile name (case-sensitive)
  --model {deepseek,qwen38,contrastive,jev}
                        Underlying generation API or decision provider
  --json                Machine output for --action only
